mapper.select: SELECT ORG_MBR_SN, FRST_CLSF_CD, FRST_CLSF_NM, SCND_CLSF_CD, SCND_CLSF_NM, TASK_CN, TELNO, SORT_SEQ, USE_YN, DEL_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_NM, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_NM, DEL_DT, DLTR_NM FROM HMPG_ORG_MEMBER WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND FRST_CLSF_CD = #{frstClsfCd} AND SCND_CLSF_CD = #{scndClsfCd} ORDER BY SORT_SEQ DESC, ORG_MBR_SN ASC

SELECT ORG_MBR_SN, FRST_CLSF_CD, FRST_CLSF_NM, SCND_CLSF_CD, SCND_CLSF_NM, TASK_CN, TELNO, SORT_SEQ, USE_YN, DEL_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_NM, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_NM, DEL_DT, DLTR_NM FROM HMPG_ORG_MEMBER WHERE ORG_MBR_SN = #{value} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE HMPG_ORG_MEMBER SET FRST_CLSF_CD = #{frstClsfCd}, FRST_CLSF_NM = #{frstClsfNm}, SCND_CLSF_CD = #{scndClsfCd}, SCND_CLSF_NM = #{scndClsfNm}, TASK_CN = #{taskCn}, TELNO = #{telno}, SORT_SEQ = #{sortSeq}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_NM = #{mdtr} WHERE ORG_MBR_SN = #{orgMbrSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
